{{short description|French nuclear physicist}}
{{Expand French|Monique Sené|topic=bio|date=March 2020}}
[[File:Monique Sené, circa 2015.png|thumb|Monique Sené, circa 2015]]
'''Monique Sené''' (born February 14, 1936)<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.hctisn.fr/IMG/pdf/cv_sene_on_line_cle45DCDD.pdf|title=Monique Sene- HCTISN}}</ref> (née Moirez)<ref name=blf>{{cite web|url=http://ilt.kuleuven.be/blf/ex_corpus.php?woord1=nommer&woord2=Sen%E9&limiet=0|title=Base lexicale du français (BLF)|work=kuleuven.be}}</ref> is a [[Nuclear physics|nuclear physicist]] and one of the co-founders of the ''[[Groupement des scientifiques pour l'information sur l'énergie nucléaire]]'' (GSIEN) (Association of Scientists for Information on Nuclear Energy) and its first president.<ref name=cahiers>{{cite journal|url=http://chrhc.revues.org/index214.html|title=Les physiciens dans le mouvement antinucléaire : entre science, expertise et politique|author=Topçu, Sezin|website=revues.org|year=2007 |issue=102 |pages=89–108 |doi=10.4000/chrhc.214 |doi-access=free}}</ref> As of March 2011 she was Honorary Research Director at the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|National Centre for Scientific Research]] and president of GSIEN.<ref name=deciphering-fukushima>{{cite web|url=http://deciphering-fukushima.blogs.sciencesetavenir.fr/tag/monique%20sen%C3%A9|title=monique sené : Deciphering Fukushima|work=sciencesetavenir.fr}}</ref> She is also Vice President of the Science Committee of ''[[Association Nationale des Comités et Commissions Locales d'Information]]'' (ANCCLI) (National Association of Local Information Committees and Commissions)<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.anccli.fr/Qu-est-ce-que-l-ANCCLI/Organigramme |title=Organigramme / Qu'est-ce que l'ANCCLI? / Accueil - Site de l'ANCCLI |accessdate=2012-05-08 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120629003455/http://www.anccli.fr/Qu-est-ce-que-l-ANCCLI/Organigramme |archivedate=2012-06-29 }}</ref> and a member of ANCCLI's {{Interlanguage link multi|High Committee for Transparency and Information on Nuclear Safety|fr|3=Haut comité pour la transparence et l’information sur la sécurité nucléaire}}.<ref name=deciphering-fukushima /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.anccli.fr/content/download/2911/41119/file/Relev%C3%A9%20decision%20reunion%20ACN%20France%2012%20avril.pdf|title=ACN Réunion des pilotes et co-pilotes de la table ronde française|publisher=ANCCLI|date=April 12, 2012|accessdate=May 8, 2012}}{{Dead link|date=April 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sbs.com.au/news/sites/sbs.com.au.news/files/transcripts/380893_dateline_thenuclearrenaissance_transcript.html|title=Transcript: Dateline, The Nuclear Renaissance|website=www.sbs.com.au|access-date=2020-03-12}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.newscientist.com/article/mg14019030-500-mini-meltdown-at-atomic-park-/|title=Mini meltdown at atomic park|last=Patel|first=Tara|website=New Scientist|language=en-US|access-date=2020-03-12}}</ref>

Although she is not an opponent of [[nuclear power]] ''per se'', Sené is a high-profile critic of the [[Nuclear power in France|French nuclear power programme]] due to concerns about its safety, the handling of [[Radioactive waste|nuclear waste]] and its imposition without public debate.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ac-grenoble.fr/yre/agency/library/missions/missrep1997/online/nuc-was4.htm |title=Nuclear Waste - Interview with Raymond et Monique Sené |access-date=2012-05-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051105001055/http://www.ac-grenoble.fr/yre/agency/library/missions/missrep1997/online/nuc-was4.htm |archive-date=2005-11-05 |url-status=dead }}</ref> She worked on [[Particle physics|high energy physics]] at the [[École Polytechnique]] at the time of GSIEN's foundation.<ref>{{cite journal|url=http://chrhc.revues.org/214|title=Les physiciens dans le mouvement antinucléaire : entre science, expertise et politique|author=Topçu, Sezin|website=revues.org|year=2007 |issue=102 |pages=89–108 |doi=10.4000/chrhc.214 |doi-access=free}}</ref>

In 1998 Monique Sené was awarded by [[Dominique Voynet]] the rank of [[Legion of Honour|Chevalier of the National Order of the Legion of Honour]] for her work as anti–nuclear power [[Activism|activist.]]<ref name=blf /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://solar-club.web.cern.ch/solar-club/gazette/1998/169_170.html|title=GAZETTE NUCLEAIRE|work=cern.ch}}</ref>
